result.rationale: Cordelio was a distinct, wholly CPP-owned platform until Pattern's share-based acquisition closed on 2026-04-01. Pattern absorbed its core assets, pipeline and team; Cordelio's site now redirects to Pattern and Pattern describes integration. CPP ceased to be Cordelio's direct owner but retained indirect exposure through a 69.1% Pattern stake. Keep one historical Cordelio record subordinate to Pattern and remove active direct CPP ownership.

identityResolution.boundary: Historical acquired company/subordinate alias; not an active manager-level PortCo.
identityResolution.legalStatus: Exact merger survivor is NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED; FCC records still use Cordelio Power Holdings LLC, so dissolution should not be inferred.

ownershipResolution.conclusion: Direct Cordelio ownership ended 2026-04-01; exposure continued indirectly through Pattern.
ownershipResolution.dealNature: Related-party consolidation, not a pure internal reorganization because Pattern had non-CPP owners.
ownershipResolution.coOwners: APG-led consortium for ABP, Australian Retirement Trust and management; Riverstone exited 2025-06-09. Stakes are NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.

operatingResolution.preClose: Wind, solar and storage IPP in the U.S. and Canada; 1,860 MW operating portfolio and over 18 GW U.S. pipeline.
operatingResolution.acquiredScope: Pattern took about 1,550 MW across 16 operating/in-construction projects, most U.S. development projects and the team.
operatingResolution.postClose: Cordelio is not separately marketed; its site redirects to Pattern and integration is ongoing.
operatingResolution.currentPatternScale: 46 operating facilities totaling about 12 GW; 40 GW development/active construction.

acquisitionExitCheck.brightNightTransaction: On 2026-04-21 BrightNight announced it had acquired Cordelio's interest in 6 GW of JV development projects. It followed Pattern's close and was a partial asset/JV sale, not a Cordelio exit; four project assets remained in the JV.
acquisitionExitCheck.laterCheck: Brand folded into Pattern; no later corporate-level sale, dissolution, financing or pending ownership deal was found through 2026-08-19.

milestones.event: CPP closed the initial 396 MW Ontario acquisition through Cordelio.
Pattern and Cordelio announced the share-based acquisition.
Acquisition closed; CPP's direct Cordelio ownership ended.
BrightNight announced its completed 6 GW JV-interest acquisition.

result.recommendedListAction: Retain cordelio-power|canada as a historical acquired record; set parent Pattern, status Acquired/Integrated and CPP direct ownership exited 2026-04-01. Record active CPP exposure only on Pattern and exclude Cordelio from CPP's active PortCo list.
